profile.headline: Tools and Automation Software Engineer
profile.summary:
- Programming skills with an emphasis on object-oriented design and creating modular and scalable
programs
- Experience working with iOS, Android, Web Applications, MacOS, Windows and various databases
- Personable with a good sense of humor

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Worked as a quality engineer for mobile development in Mobile Sports and Industrial Toys.
- Created automation scripts in C#, C++ and Unreal Blueprints to improve testing quality and
speed.
- Managed and created MSSQL databases and stored procedures.
- Modified MySQL databases for mocking test player metadata.
- Modified AI bot logic in order to mimic player behavior using C++ and Behavior Trees in Unreal.
- Made applications and processes to aid stakeholders in completing their day to day tasks.
- Designed and implemented new automation tools to aid in the quality verification process.
- Created technical design documents to plan out feature implementations.
- Implemented inversion of control to help breakup dependencies in monolithic projects.
- Added unit tests in the C# code base to improve code quality and health of the solution.
- Integrated automation with Jenkins, Slack and Unreal to report test results and build health.
- Worked closely with stakeholders to communicate feature status and priorities, leading
discussions driving next steps for continuous improvement.
- Completed code reviews to help maintain standards of quality in change submissions.
- Received various employee spot stock awards for the delivery of features of quality in a timely
manner while maintaining open communication with stakeholders.
positions.insights: Unreal Engine 4, Python (Programming Language) and +10 skills

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Maintained mobile application using C#, Javascript, TypeScript, and Razor as a single page app.
- Performed onsite support and training for sales teams using the mobile app.
- Completed overnight deployments with a team, each taking responsibility for the successful
launch and validation of individual applications.
- Created new features and improvements to various sales applications, including adding pdf
templates to be written to and printed.
- Improved the speed and quality of the mobile application by refactoring old code and fixing
several redundancies.
- Helped migrate the project from Team Foundation Version Control to Git.
- Wrote, maintained, and refactored several SQL tables, stored procedures and view windows.
- Maintained database source control using RedGate.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Front to end development in the payments space using C# .Net Framework.
- Integrated with multiple
banks to automate the payment process.
- Helped to develop and upkeep customer support web tooling using C#, JavaScript and CSHTML.
- Updated and wrote SQL scripts and stored procedures to support various features.
- Refactored complicated and slow queries to use Elasticsearch in order to improve speed and search
quality.
- Primarily used a Request Response model to interact across a 4-tier system.
- Created a WPF application to help monitor and update configuration files.
- Wrote PowerShell scripts to improve day today development tasks.
- Worked with NServicebus to send and route request messages.
- Automated the password update process with third party tooling.
- Worked intimately with Image Cache Letter (ICL), Automated Clearing House (ACH), paper check and
credit card payments.
- Used a GIT repository for source control, rebasing and merging various feature branches into the
development branch.
- Worked on and followed features across each development cycle in the AGILE process using Jira.
- Maintained and wrote unit tests using NUnit in order to promote code quality and health.
